title: Read and Ignore: What Self-Directed LLM Agents Do in Public Service Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2611.15460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent's decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect $2{,}400$ trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with $1{,}000$ runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in $96.9\%$ of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in $18.7\%$; with an explicit task, $86.0\%$ produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ($18.7\%$ vs.\ $16.0\%$), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman $0.79$), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ($0.19$). translated_title: 阅读与忽视：自主导向的大语言模型智能体在公共服务场景中的行为
translated_abstract: 当指令不够明确时，大语言模型（LLM）智能体需要自行决定要做什么。在公共服务领域，这些指令由工作人员编写，但智能体的决策会影响居民、患者和学生。我们构建了四个经过专家验证的公共服务场景，其中包含可从文件中查验的记录和决策杠杆，收集了十个LLM在四种提示条件下的2400条运行轨迹，并与无上下文沙盒中的1000次运行进行了对比。在开放式运行中，智能体在96.9%的情况下会阅读记录，但仅在18.7%的情况下会产出成果或自选任务；在给定明确任务时，这一比例升至86.0%。领域背景并不改变产出成果的比例（18.7%对比16.0%），且各模型产出能力的排名大体保持一致（Spearman相关系数0.79），而模型是否阅读记录的排名则不然（0.19）。上下文背景将每次运行中的边界试探轮次减少了60%，且某些产出成果与记录内容相矛盾。
tldr: 该研究构建了四个专家验证的公共服务场景，发现LLM智能体在指令不明确时虽然几乎总会阅读记录（96.9%），却很少主动产出任务成果（仅18.7%），且领域背景不改变其产出行为、部分产出甚至与记录内容相矛盾。
en_tdlr: This study builds four expert-validated public-service scenarios and finds that self-directed LLM agents almost always read the records (96.9%) but rarely take initiative to produce outputs (18.7%), with domain context not changing production behavior and some produced artifacts contradicting the records.
